description: For one deal (id from the other tools): product identity, seller, what the shopper must do for the price, known and unknown costs, the reference the discount is measured against (and whether it is verified), matched offers at other retailers, how recent the verification is, and the checks we ran (successful and failed). Each deal starts with summary_one_line (quote it as written). Cite canonical_url, buy via go_url (unchanged), and always give price.as_of and check.state (verified_fresh, as_posted, stale, price_changed, out_of_stock, unpriced, expired: see methodology_url). Savings appear only against a verified reference. These are the same evidence Covetta, PostThisDeal’s deal assistant, uses.
name: get_black_friday_evidence
title: Evidence behind one Black Friday deal
